narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='c1'/>The yellow tiles make squares, so Step ten has ten squared, one hundred tiles.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Step one has nine tiles, which is three squared, not one squared.
<bookmark mark='c3'/>The side is always two more than the step number.
